name: Alberta Rangeland Sustainability Program
summary: Grants to organisations for projects that conserve and sustain Alberta's rangelands, including native grassland restoration, species-at-risk protection, wildfire resilience, research and extension. Individuals cannot apply.
reporting: Recipients complete annual reports and one final report covering project status and expenditures.
